intro.en: A father and his son who graduated as an engineer talk about finding a job. Learn new words about work, study and unemployment.
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein ek baap aur uska beta, jo engineer ban chuka hai, naukri ki talaash par baat karte hain. Kaam, parhai aur berozgari ke naye alfaaz seekhenge.
intro.ar: أَبٌ وَابْنُهُ الَّذي تَخَرَّجَ مُهَنْدِساً يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنِ البَحْثِ عَنْ عَمَلٍ. تَتَعَلَّمُ كَلِماتٍ جَديدَةً عَنِ العَمَلِ وَالدِّراسَةِ وَالبِطالَةِ.

dialogue.ar: لَعَلَّ نَتيجَةَ المُقابَلَةِ طَيِّبَةٌ اليَوْمَ.
dialogue.tr: laʿalla natījata l-muqābalati ṭayyibatun al-yawm
dialogue.en: Perhaps the result of the interview is good today.
dialogue.ur: Shayad aaj interview ka nateeja achha ho.

dialogue.ar: قابَلْتُ مُديرَ الشَّرِكَةِ، وَرَأى شَهاداتي، لَكِنَّني غَيْرُ مُتَفائِلٍ.
dialogue.tr: qābaltu mudīra sh-sharika, wa raʾā shahādātī, lakinnanī ghayru mutafāʾil
dialogue.en: I met the company manager and he saw my certificates, but I am not optimistic.
dialogue.ur: Maine company ke manager se mulaqat ki aur unhon ne meri sanadein dekhin, lekin main pur-umeed nahin hoon.

dialogue.ar: ما سَبَبُ ذَلِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: mā sababu dhālika?
dialogue.en: What is the reason for that?
dialogue.ur: Iski kya wajah hai?

dialogue.ar: الشَّرِكَةُ تَحْتاجُ إِلى عَشَرَةِ مُهَنْدِسينَ، وَقَدَّمَ لِلْعَمَلِ مِئَةُ مُهَنْدِسٍ، مُعْظَمُهُمْ لَهُمْ خِبْراتٌ طَويلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: ash-sharika taḥtāju ilā ʿasharati muhandisīn, wa qaddama lil-ʿamali miʾatu muhandis, muʿẓamuhum lahum khibrātun ṭawīla
dialogue.en: The company needs ten engineers, and one hundred engineers applied; most of them have long experience.
dialogue.ur: Company ko das engineers chahiye aur sau engineers ne darkhwast di; un mein se aksar ka tajurba lamba hai.

dialogue.ar: سَتَجِدُ العَمَلَ المُناسِبَ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: sa-tajidu l-ʿamala l-munāsib, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: You will find the suitable job, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Tumhein munasib kaam mil jayega, inshaAllah.

dialogue.ar: أَنا آسِفٌ يا أَبي، لِأَنَّني دَرَسْتُ الهَنْدَسَةَ. لَقَدْ تَخَرَّجْتُ في كُلِّيَّةِ الهَنْدَسَةِ مُنْذُ سَنَتَيْنِ، وَلَمْ أَعْمَلْ حَتَّى الآنَ.
dialogue.tr: anā āsif yā abī, li-annanī darastu l-handasa. laqad takharrajtu fī kulliyyati l-handasati mundhu sanatayn, wa lam aʿmal ḥattā l-ān
dialogue.en: I am sorry, father, because I studied engineering. I graduated from the engineering college two years ago and have not worked until now.
dialogue.ur: Abbu, main maazrat chahta hoon kyunke maine engineering parhi. Mujhe engineering college se nikle do saal ho gaye aur ab tak kaam nahin mila.

dialogue.ar: لَيْسَتِ المُشْكِلَةُ في دِراسَةِ الهَنْدَسَةِ، المُشْكِلَةُ في البِطالَةِ، الَّتي تَعُمُّ كُلَّ العالَمِ، حَيْثُ يَتَخَرَّجُ الطُّلابُ في الجامِعاتِ وَالمَعاهِدِ المُخْتَلِفَةِ، وَلا يَجِدونَ عَمَلاً.
dialogue.tr: laysati l-mushkilatu fī dirāsati l-handasa, al-mushkilatu fī l-biṭāla, allatī taʿummu kulla l-ʿālam, ḥaythu yatakharrajuṭ-ṭullāb fī l-jāmiʿāt wal-maʿāhidi l-mukhtalifa, wa lā yajidūna ʿamalan
dialogue.en: The problem is not in studying engineering; the problem is unemployment, which spreads across the whole world, where students graduate from different universities and institutes and do not find work.
dialogue.ur: Masla engineering parhne mein nahin, berozgari mein hai jo poori duniya mein phaili hui hai; talba mukhtalif jamiaat aur idaron se nikalte hain aur unhein kaam nahin milta.

dialogue.ar: نُريدُ مُساعَدَةَ أَهْلِنا، وَنُريدُ الزَّواجَ، لَكِنَّنا لا نَسْتَطيعُ.
dialogue.tr: nurīdu musāʿadata ahlinā, wa nurīdu z-zawāj, lakinnanā lā nastaṭīʿ
dialogue.en: We want to help our families and we want to marry, but we cannot.
dialogue.ur: Hum apne gharwalon ki madad karna aur shaadi karna chahte hain, lekin nahin kar sakte.

dialogue.ar: تَقولُ الحُكومَةُ: سَتَكونُ هُناكَ فُرَصُ عَمَلٍ كَثيرَةٌ لِلشَّبابِ هَذا العامَ.
dialogue.tr: taqūlu l-ḥukūma: sa-takūnu hunāka furaṣu ʿamalin kathīra lish-shabābi hādhā l-ʿām
dialogue.en: The government says there will be many job opportunities for young people this year.
dialogue.ur: Hukumat kehti hai ke is saal naujawanon ke liye naukriyon ke bohat mauqe honge.

dialogue.ar: سَمِعْنا هَذا الكَلامَ كَثيراً. نَحْنُ نُريدُ عَمَلاً، لا كَلاماً.
dialogue.tr: samiʿnā hādhā l-kalāma kathīrā. naḥnu nurīdu ʿamalan, lā kalāmā
dialogue.en: We have heard this talk a lot. We want work, not talk.
dialogue.ur: Hum ye baatein bohat sun chuke. Hum kaam chahte hain, baatein nahin.

dialogue.ar: كُنْ مُتَفائِلاً.
dialogue.tr: kun mutafāʾilā
dialogue.en: Be optimistic.
dialogue.ur: Pur-umeed raho.

vocab.ur: usne (kisi idare se) tahseel mukammal ki

q.en: The company needs ten engineers. How many applied?
q.ur: Company ko das engineers chahiye. Kitne ne darkhwast di?
q.ar: تَحْتاجُ الشَّرِكَةُ إِلى عَشَرَةِ مُهَنْدِسينَ. فَكَمْ شَخْصاً تَقَدَّمَ لِلْعَمَلِ؟

intro.en: Hamzat al-waṣl is pronounced at the start of speech and is NOT pronounced in the middle. Example: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» (pronounced) but «ما اسْمُكَ؟» (not pronounced).
intro.ur: Hamzat al-wasl bolne ki shuruaat mein parhi jati hai, darmiyan mein nahin parhi jati. Misal: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» (parhi gayi) lekin «ما اسْمُكَ؟» (nahin parhi gayi).
intro.ar: هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ تُنْطَقُ في بِدايَةِ الكَلامِ وَلا تُنْطَقُ في وَسَطِهِ. مِثْلُ: «اِسْمُكَ عَلِيّ» وَ«ما اسْمُكَ؟».

q.ur: Hamzat al-wasl kab parhi jati hai?

q.en: In which sentence is it NOT pronounced?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein nahin parhi jati?
q.ar: في أَيِّ جُمْلَةٍ لا تُنْطَقُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ؟

q.en: In which sentence is it pronounced?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein parhi jati hai?
q.ar: في أَيِّ جُمْلَةٍ تُنْطَقُ هَمْزَةُ الوَصْلِ؟

q.en: Which word starts with hamzat al-waṣl?
q.ur: Kaun sa lafz hamzat al-wasl se shuru hota hai?

intro.en: Negation is the opposite of affirmation. Its tools are: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. Example: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» becomes «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ».
intro.ur: Nafi, isbat ka ulta hai. Iske alfaaz hain: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. Misal: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» se «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» bana.
intro.ar: النَّفْيُ عَكْسُ الإِثْباتِ، وَأَدَواتُهُ: ما، لا، لَنْ، لَمْ، لَيْسَ. مِثالٌ: «يَصومُ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ» يُصْبِحُ «لَنْ يَصومَ سَعيدٌ اليَوْمَ».

q.en: Which is NOT a negation tool?
q.ur: Inmein se nafi ka lafz kaun sa nahin hai?

q.en: Which tool is used for the future (will not)?
q.ur: Mustaqbil (nahin karega) ke liye kaun sa lafz?
q.ar: أَيُّ أَداةٍ تَنْفي الفِعْلَ في المُسْتَقْبَلِ؟

intro.en: Practise the negation tools and talk about jobs: engineer, doctor, teacher, pilot and pharmacist. Ask a friend: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»
intro.ur: Is sabaq mein nafi ki mashq karenge aur peshon ki baat karenge: engineer, doctor, teacher, pilot aur pharmacist. Dost se poochein: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى أَدَواتِ النَّفْيِ وَتَحَدَّثْ عَنِ المِهَنِ: المُهَنْدِسُ وَالطَّبيبُ وَالمُعَلِّمُ وَالطَّيّارُ وَالصَّيْدَلِيُّ. اِسْأَلْ صَديقَكَ: «هَلْ تُفَضِّلُ أَنْ تَكونَ مُهَنْدِساً؟ وَلِماذا؟»

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَبيعُ الأَدْوِيَةَ وَيُحَضِّرُها؟

intro.en: A reading passage about three different opinions on whether a woman should work outside her home. The text only reports what each group says. Notice how it uses «فَريق» (group) and «يَرى» (he sees / thinks).
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn jis mein teen mukhtalif raaye bayan hui hain ke aurat ghar se bahar kaam kare ya nahin. Matn sirf har giroh ki baat batata hai. Dhyan dein: «فَريق» (giroh) aur «يَرى» (woh samajhta hai).
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلْقِراءَةِ فيهِ ثَلاثَةُ آراءٍ في عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ خارِجَ بَيْتِها. يَنْقُلُ النَّصُّ ما يَقولُهُ كُلُّ فَريقٍ فَقَط. اِنْتَبِهْ إِلى كَلِمَةِ «فَريق» وَالفِعْلِ «يَرى».

dialogue.ar: هَلْ تَعْمَلُ المَرْأَةُ خارِجَ بَيْتِها، أَمْ لا تَعْمَلُ؟ يَخْتَلِفُ النّاسُ في الإِجابَةِ عَنْ هَذا السُّؤالِ إِلى ثَلاثِ فِرَقٍ.
dialogue.tr: hal taʿmalu l-marʾatu khārija baytihā, am lā taʿmal? yakhtalifu n-nāsu fī l-ijābati ʿan hādhā s-suʾāli ilā thalāthi firaq
dialogue.en: Does a woman work outside her home or not? People differ in answering this question into three groups.
dialogue.ur: Kya aurat ghar se bahar kaam karti hai ya nahin? Is sawal ke jawab mein log teen giroh mein baant jate hain.

dialogue.ar: فَريقٌ يَقولُ: نَعَمْ، يَجِبُ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ المَرْأَةُ خارِجَ بَيْتِها، مِثْلَ الرَّجُلِ.
dialogue.tr: farīqun yaqūlu: naʿam, yajibu an taʿmala l-marʾatu khārija baytihā, mithla r-rajul
dialogue.en: One group says: yes, a woman must work outside her home, like a man.
dialogue.ur: Ek giroh kehta hai: haan, aurat ko ghar se bahar kaam karna chahiye, mard ki tarah.

dialogue.ar: وَفَريقٌ آخَرُ يَقولُ: لا يَصِحُّ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ المَرْأَةُ خارِجَ بَيْتِها.
dialogue.tr: wa farīqun ākharu yaqūl: lā yaṣiḥḥu an taʿmala l-marʾatu khārija baytihā
dialogue.en: Another group says: it is not right for a woman to work outside her home.
dialogue.ur: Doosra giroh kehta hai: aurat ka ghar se bahar kaam karna durust nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَفَريقٌ ثالِثٌ يَقولُ: تَعْمَلُ المَرْأَةُ خارِجَ بَيْتِها، وَلَكِنْ بِشَرْطٍ.
dialogue.tr: wa farīqun thālithun yaqūl: taʿmalu l-marʾatu khārija baytihā, wa lākin bi-sharṭ
dialogue.en: A third group says: a woman works outside her home, but on a condition.
dialogue.ur: Teesra giroh kehta hai: aurat ghar se bahar kaam karti hai, lekin ek shart ke saath.

dialogue.ar: يَقولُ الفَريقُ الأَوَّلُ: إِنَّ المَرْأَةَ نِصْفُ المُجْتَمَعِ، وَلا يَصِحُّ أَنْ تَجْلِسَ في بَيْتِها؛ تَغْسِلُ المَلابِسَ، وَتُعِدُّ الطَّعامَ، وَتُنَظِّفُ البَيْتَ، وَتُرَبّي الأَوْلادَ.
dialogue.tr: yaqūlu l-farīqu l-awwal: inna l-marʾata niṣfu l-mujtamaʿ, wa lā yaṣiḥḥu an tajlisa fī baytihā; taghsilu l-malābis, wa tuʿiddu ṭ-ṭaʿām, wa tunaẓẓifu l-bayt, wa turabbī l-awlād
dialogue.en: The first group says: a woman is half of society, and it is not right for her to sit at home washing clothes, preparing food, cleaning the house and raising the children.
dialogue.ur: Pehla giroh kehta hai: aurat aadha muashra hai aur use ghar mein baith kar kapde dhone, khana banane, safai karne aur bachon ki tarbiyat tak mehdood rehna durust nahin.

dialogue.ar: وَيَرى الفَريقُ الثّاني أَنَّ وَظيفَةَ المَرْأَةِ الأَساسِيَّةَ تَكونُ في البَيْتِ؛ حَيْثُ تُديرُهُ، وَتُرَبّي أَوْلادَها.
dialogue.tr: wa yarā l-farīqu th-thānī anna waẓīfata l-marʾati l-asāsiyyata takūnu fī l-bayt; ḥaythu tudīruhu, wa turabbī awlādahā
dialogue.en: The second group sees that a woman's main job is in the home, where she runs it and raises her children.
dialogue.ur: Doosra giroh samajhta hai ke aurat ka asal kaam ghar mein hai, jahan woh ghar chalati aur apne bachon ki tarbiyat karti hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَقولُ هَذا الفَريقُ: إِنَّ خُروجَ المَرْأَةِ مِنَ البَيْتِ يُؤَدّي إِلى تَفَكُّكِ الأُسْرَةِ، وَضَياعِ الأَوْلادِ.
dialogue.tr: wa yaqūlu hādhā l-farīq: inna khurūja l-marʾati mina l-bayti yuʾaddī ilā tafakkuki l-usra, wa ḍayāʿi l-awlād
dialogue.en: This group says: a woman leaving the home leads to the breakdown of the family and the loss of the children.
dialogue.ur: Yeh giroh kehta hai: aurat ka ghar se nikalna khandan ke bikharne aur bachon ke zaya hone tak le jata hai.

dialogue.ar: أَمّا الفَريقُ الثّالِثُ، فَيَرى أَنَّ العَمَلَ حَقٌّ لِلْمَرْأَةِ، فَتَعْمَلُ عَمَلَها الأَساسِيَّ في بَيْتِها، وَلَها أَنْ تَعْمَلَ خارِجَ بَيْتِها، بِشَرْطِ أَنْ تَعْمَلَ في المَجالاتِ الَّتي تُناسِبُها، وَتَحْفَظَ أَخْلاقَها.
dialogue.tr: ammā l-farīqu th-thālith, fa-yarā anna l-ʿamala ḥaqqun lil-marʾa, fa-taʿmalu ʿamalahā l-asāsiyya fī baytihā, wa lahā an taʿmala khārija baytihā, bi-sharṭi an taʿmala fil-majālāti llatī tunāsibuhā, wa taḥfaẓa akhlāqahā
dialogue.en: As for the third group, it sees that work is a right for a woman: she does her main work in her home, and she may work outside it, on condition that she works in fields that suit her and keeps her good character.
dialogue.ur: Teesra giroh samajhta hai ke kaam aurat ka haq hai: woh apna asal kaam ghar mein karti hai aur ghar se bahar bhi kaam kar sakti hai, is shart par ke woh munasib shobon mein kaam kare aur apne akhlaq ki hifazat kare.

dialogue.ar: فَتَعْمَلُ طَبيبَةً، أَوْ مُمَرِّضَةً، أَوْ مُعَلِّمَةً، أَوْ مُرَبِّيَةً.
dialogue.tr: fa-taʿmalu ṭabība, aw mumarriḍa, aw muʿallima, aw murabbiya
dialogue.en: So she works as a doctor, a nurse, a teacher or a carer.
dialogue.ur: Chunancha woh doctor, nurse, ustaani ya murabbiya ban kar kaam karti hai.

q.en: How many groups does the text mention?
The first group says a woman is:
The third group says a woman may work if:
q.ur: Teesre giroh ke mutabiq aurat kaam kar sakti hai agar:
q.ar: يَرى الفَريقُ الثّالِثُ أَنَّ المَرْأَةَ تَعْمَلُ إِذا:

intro.en: A verb is of two kinds. Intransitive (لازِم) does not need an object: «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ». Transitive (مُتَعَدٍّ) needs an object: «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ» (she washes what? the clothes).
intro.ur: Fe'l ki do qismein hain. Laazim ko maful bih nahin chahiye: «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ». Muta'addi ko maful bih chahiye: «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ» (kya dhoti hai? kapde).
intro.ar: الفِعْلُ نَوْعانِ: لازِمٌ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ مِثْلُ «يَفْرَحُ الطُّلابُ بِالنَّجاحِ»، وَمُتَعَدٍّ يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ مِثْلُ «تَغْسِلُ المَرْأَةُ المَلابِسَ».

q.en: Which sentence has a transitive verb?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein muta'addi fe'l hai?

q.en: Which sentence has an intransitive verb?
q.ur: Kis jumle mein laazim fe'l hai?

options: A verb that does not need an object
A verb that needs an object
options_ar: فِعْلٌ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى مَفْعولٍ بِهِ

q.en: In «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ» what is the object?
q.ur: «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ» mein maful bih kaun hai?
q.ar: ما المَفْعولُ بِهِ في جُمْلَةِ «تُديرُ الزَّوْجَةُ البَيْتَ»؟

intro.en: Two friends, Salah and Imad, talk about Salah travelling abroad to work and how to keep one's religion, culture and language.
intro.ur: Do dost, Salah aur Imad, Salah ke kaam ke liye pardes jaane par baat karte hain aur is par ke apna deen, saqafat aur zubaan kaise mehfooz rakhein.
intro.ar: صَديقانِ، صَلاحٌ وَعِمادٌ، يَتَحَدَّثانِ عَنْ سَفَرِ صَلاحٍ لِلْعَمَلِ خارِجَ بَلَدِهِ وَكَيْفَ يُحافِظُ الإِنْسانُ عَلى دينِهِ وَثَقافَتِهِ وَلُغَتِهِ.

dialogue.ar: سَأَغْتَرِبُ لِلْعَمَلِ خارِجَ وَطَني.
dialogue.tr: sa-aghtaribu lil-ʿamali khārija waṭanī
dialogue.en: I will go abroad to work outside my homeland.
dialogue.ur: Main kaam ke liye apne watan se bahar jaunga.

dialogue.ar: لَكِنَّكَ تَعْمَلُ هُنا، وَراتِبُكَ جَيِّدٌ.
dialogue.tr: lakinnaka taʿmalu hunā, wa rātibuka jayyid
dialogue.en: But you work here, and your salary is good.
dialogue.ur: Lekin tum yahan kaam karte ho aur tumhari tankhwah achhi hai.

dialogue.ar: المالُ كَثيرٌ هُناكَ، وَالحَياةُ سَهْلَةٌ.
dialogue.tr: al-mālu kathīrun hunāk, wal-ḥayātu sahla
dialogue.en: Money is plentiful there, and life is easy.
dialogue.ur: Wahan paisa bohat hai aur zindagi aasaan hai.

dialogue.ar: أَخْتَلِفُ مَعَكَ. بِلادُنا تَحْتاجُ إِلَيْنا.
dialogue.tr: akhtalifu maʿak. bilādunā taḥtāju ilaynā
dialogue.en: I disagree with you. Our country needs us.
dialogue.ur: Main tumse ikhtilaf karta hoon. Hamare mulk ko hamari zaroorat hai.

dialogue.ar: السَّفَرُ لِلْعَمَلِ حَلالٌ، وَلَيْسَ حَراماً. قالَ اللهُ تَعالى: هُوَ الَّذي جَعَلَ لَكُمُ الأَرْضَ ذَلولاً فَامْشُوا في مَناكِبِها وَكُلوا مِنْ رِزْقِهِ وَإِلَيْهِ النُّشورُ.
dialogue.tr: as-safaru lil-ʿamali ḥalāl, wa laysa ḥarāmā. qāla llāhu taʿālā: huwa lladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa dhalūlan fa-mshū fī manākibihā wa kulū min rizqih, wa ilayhi n-nushūr
dialogue.en: Travelling for work is lawful, not forbidden. Allah the Most High said: "It is He who made the earth tame for you, so walk in its tracts and eat of His provision, and to Him is the resurrection."
dialogue.ur: Kaam ke liye safar halal hai, haram nahin. Allah Ta'ala ne farmaya: "Wohi hai jis ne tumhare liye zameen ko tabe kar diya, pas us ke raston mein chalo aur uska rizq khao, aur usi ki taraf uthna hai." (Surah Al-Mulk)

dialogue.ar: صَدَقَ اللهُ العَظيمُ. وَلَكِنْ هَلْ فَكَّرْتَ في أَوْلادِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: ṣadaqa llāhu l-ʿaẓīm. wa lākin hal fakkarta fī awlādik?
dialogue.en: Allah the Almighty has spoken the truth. But have you thought about your children?
dialogue.ur: Allah Azeem ne sach farmaya. Lekin kya tumne apne bachon ke baare mein socha?

dialogue.ar: سَأَصْطَحِبُهُمْ مَعي، أَوْ أَزورُهُمْ في العامِ مَرَّتَيْنِ.
dialogue.tr: sa-aṣṭaḥibuhum maʿī, aw azūruhum fil-ʿāmi marratayn
dialogue.en: I will take them with me, or visit them twice a year.
dialogue.ur: Main unhein apne saath le jaunga ya saal mein do baar unse milne aunga.

dialogue.ar: كَيْفَ تُحافِظُ عَلى دينِهِمْ وَثَقافَتِهِمْ وَلُغَتِهِمْ، إِذا اغْتَرَبوا مَعَكَ؟
dialogue.tr: kayfa tuḥāfiẓu ʿalā dīnihim wa thaqāfatihim wa lughatihim, idhā ightarabū maʿak?
dialogue.en: How will you protect their religion, culture and language if they live abroad with you?
dialogue.ur: Agar woh tumhare saath pardes gaye to tum unke deen, saqafat aur zubaan ki hifazat kaise karoge?

dialogue.ar: لَنْ أَذْهَبَ إِلى بِلادٍ غَريبَةٍ عَنْ ثَقافَتي.
dialogue.tr: lan adhhaba ilā bilādin gharībatin ʿan thaqāfatī
dialogue.en: I will not go to countries strange to my culture.
dialogue.ur: Main aise mulkon mein nahin jaunga jo meri saqafat se anjaan hon.

dialogue.ar: أَرْجو أَنْ تَصْحَبَ أَوْلادَكَ.
dialogue.tr: arjū an taṣḥaba awlādak
dialogue.en: I hope you take your children with you.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe umeed hai tum apne bachon ko saath le jaoge.

dialogue.ar: سَأُحاوِلُ ذَلِكَ، وَشُكْراً عَلى نَصيحَتِكَ.
dialogue.tr: sa-uḥāwilu dhālik, wa shukran ʿalā naṣīḥatik
dialogue.en: I will try that, and thank you for your advice.
dialogue.ur: Main koshish karunga, aur tumhari naseehat ka shukriya.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ وافَقَ والِدُكَ عَلى اغْتِرابِكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal wāfaqa wālduka ʿalā ightirābik?
dialogue.en: Did your father agree to your living abroad?
dialogue.ur: Kya tumhare walid ne tumhare pardes jaane par ittefaq kiya?

dialogue.ar: بِالطَّبْعِ وافَقَ، وَإِلّا ما فَكَّرْتُ في الاغْتِرابِ.
dialogue.tr: bit-ṭabʿi wāfaq, wa illā mā fakkartu fil-ightirāb
dialogue.en: Of course he agreed, otherwise I would not have thought of going abroad.
dialogue.ur: Zaroor ittefaq kiya, warna main pardes ke baare mein sochta hi nahin.

dialogue.ar: هَلْ سَتُقيمُ طَويلاً هُناكَ؟
dialogue.tr: hal sa-tuqīmu ṭawīlan hunāk?
dialogue.en: Will you stay long there?
dialogue.ur: Kya tum wahan lambe arse tak rahoge?

dialogue.ar: خَمْسَ سَنَواتٍ فَقَطْ، ثُمَّ أَعودُ، إِنْ شاءَ اللهُ.
dialogue.tr: khamsa sanawātin faqaṭ, thumma aʿūd, in shāʾa llāh
dialogue.en: Only five years, then I will return, God willing.
dialogue.ur: Sirf paanch saal, phir wapas aaunga, inshaAllah.

dialogue.ar: أَرْجو أَنْ تَعودَ إِلَيْنا سالِماً غانِماً.
dialogue.tr: arjū an taʿūda ilaynā sāliman ghānimā
dialogue.en: I hope you return to us safe and successful.
dialogue.ur: Umeed hai tum salamati aur kamyabi ke saath wapas aaoge.

dialogue.ar: بارَكَ اللهُ فيكَ.
dialogue.tr: bāraka llāhu fīk
dialogue.en: May Allah bless you.
dialogue.ur: Allah tumhein barkat de.

q.en: How long will Salah stay abroad?

q.ur: Imad kis baat se fikarmand hai?

intro.en: Pointing words: for near: هَذا (this, masculine), هَذِهِ (this, feminine), هُنا (here), هَذانِ، هاتانِ (two), هَؤُلاءِ (these). For far: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.
intro.ur: Ishara ke alfaaz: qareeb ke liye: هَذا (yeh, muzakkar), هَذِهِ (yeh, muannas), هُنا (yahan), هَذانِ، هاتانِ (do ke liye), هَؤُلاءِ (yeh sab). Door ke liye: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.
intro.ar: أَسْماءُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْقَريبِ: هَذا، هَذِهِ، هُنا، هَذانِ، هاتانِ، هَؤُلاءِ. وَلِلْبَعيدِ: ذَلِكَ، تِلْكَ، هُناكَ.

q.en: "This" for a masculine singular noun near you:
q.ur: Qareeb ke muzakkar wahid ke liye "yeh":
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ القَريبِ؟

q.en: "That" for a masculine noun far away:
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِلْمُفْرَدِ المُذَكَّرِ البَعيدِ؟

q.en: "These" (for a group of men and women):
q.ar: ما اسْمُ الإِشارَةِ لِجَماعَةِ الرِّجالِ وَالنِّساءِ؟

q.en: Choose: «.....طالِبانِ في الثّانَوِيَّةِ» (two male students, near)
q.ar: اِخْتَرْ: «.....طالِبانِ في الثّانَوِيَّةِ» (إِشارَةٌ إِلى اثْنَيْنِ قَريبَيْنِ).

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue about a married couple who work as doctors, then discuss the topic of working abroad with your classmate.
intro.ur: Ek shaadi-shuda jode ki baat sunein jo doctor hain, phir apne sathi ke saath pardes mein kaam ke mauzu par baat karein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنْ زَوْجَيْنِ يَعْمَلانِ طَبيبَيْنِ، ثُمَّ تَحَدَّثْ مَعْ زَميلِكَ عَنِ العَمَلِ خارِجَ الوَطَنِ.

intro.en: A reading about the value of work in Islam, with a story from the time of the Prophet ﷺ about a poor man who was told to work with his own hands. The text quotes the Prophet ﷺ; read it with respect.
intro.ur: Kaam ki ahmiyat par ek matn, jis mein Nabi ﷺ ke zamane ka waqia hai ke ek faqeer ko apne haathon se kaam karne ko kaha gaya. Matn mein Nabi ﷺ ke farameen hain; adab ke saath parhein.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ عَنْ قيمَةِ العَمَلِ في الإِسْلامِ، فيهِ قِصَّةٌ مِنْ عَهْدِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ عَنْ رَجُلٍ فَقيرٍ أُمِرَ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ بِيَدِهِ. يَنْقُلُ النَّصُّ كَلامَ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ فَاقْرَأْهُ بِاحْتِرامٍ.

dialogue.ar: العَمَلُ نِعْمَةٌ مِنْ نِعَمِ اللهِ، وَلا يَعْرِفُ هَذِهِ النِّعْمَةَ إِلّا مَنْ فَقَدَها بِسَبَبِ المَرَضِ، أَوْ غَيْرِهِ.
dialogue.tr: al-ʿamalu niʿmatun min niʿami llāh, wa lā yaʿrifu hādhihi n-niʿmata illā man faqadahā bi-sababi l-maraḍ, aw ghayrih
dialogue.en: Work is a blessing from Allah's blessings, and only one who lost it through illness or something else knows this blessing.
dialogue.ur: Kaam Allah ki nematon mein se ek nemat hai, aur is nemat ko wahi pehchanta hai jisne beemari ya kisi aur wajah se use kho diya ho.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ ذَلِكَ فَبَعْضُ النّاسِ لا يُحِبّونَ العَمَلَ، وَيَعْتَمِدونَ عَلى غَيْرِهِمْ، أَوْ يَتَسَوَّلونَ في الطُّرُقِ.
dialogue.tr: wa maʿa dhālika fa-baʿḍu n-nāsi lā yuḥibbūna l-ʿamal, wa yaʿtamidūna ʿalā ghayrihim, aw yatasawwalūna fiṭ-ṭuruq
dialogue.en: Yet some people do not love work; they depend on others or beg in the streets.
dialogue.ur: Phir bhi kuch log kaam pasand nahin karte; woh doosron par bharosa karte hain ya sadkon par bheek mangte hain.

dialogue.ar: قالَ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: «ما أَكَلَ أَحَدٌ طَعاماً قَطُّ خَيْراً مِنْ أَنْ يَأْكُلَ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ، وَإِنَّ نَبِيَّ اللهِ داوُدَ كانَ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ».
dialogue.tr: qāla r-rasūlu ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam: mā akala aḥadun ṭaʿāman qaṭṭu khayran min an yaʾkula min ʿamali yadih, wa inna nabiyya llāhi Dāwūda kāna yaʾkulu min ʿamali yadih
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said: "No one has ever eaten better food than that which he eats from the work of his own hand, and the Prophet of Allah Dawud used to eat from the work of his hand."
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kisi ne kabhi is se behtar khana nahin khaya ke woh apne haath ki kamai se khaye, aur Allah ke nabi Dawud (alaihis salam) apne haath ki kamai se khate the."

dialogue.ar: وَقالَ: «لَأَنْ يَأْخُذَ أَحَدُكُمْ حَبْلَهُ، ثُمَّ يَغْدُوَ إِلى الجَبَلِ، فَيَحْتَطِبَ، فَيَبيعَ، فَيَأْكُلَ، وَيَتَصَدَّقَ خَيْرٌ مِنْ أَنْ يَسْأَلَ النّاسَ».
dialogue.tr: wa qāla: la-an yaʾkhudha aḥadukum ḥablahu, thumma yaghduwa ilā l-jabal, fa-yaḥtaṭiba, fa-yabīʿa, fa-yaʾkula, wa yataṣaddaqa khayrun min an yasʾala n-nās
dialogue.en: And he said: "That one of you takes his rope, goes to the mountain, gathers wood, sells it, eats and gives charity, is better than asking people."
dialogue.ur: Aur farmaya: "Tum mein se koi apni rassi le, pahaar ki taraf jaye, lakdiyan chune, bech kar khaye aur sadqa de, yeh is se behtar hai ke logon se maange."

dialogue.ar: جاءَ رَجُلٌ فَقيرٌ إِلى رَسولِ اللهِ ﷺ وَسَأَلَهُ شَيْئاً، فَقالَ لَهُ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: هَلْ في بَيْتِكَ شَيْءٌ؟
dialogue.tr: jāʾa rajulun faqīrun ilā rasūli llāhi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa sallam wa saʾalahu shayʾā, fa-qāla lahu r-rasūl: hal fī baytika shayʾ?
dialogue.en: A poor man came to the Messenger of Allah ﷺ and asked him for something. The Messenger ﷺ said to him: "Is there anything in your house?"
dialogue.ur: Ek faqeer aadmi Rasoolullah ﷺ ke paas aaya aur kuch maanga. Aap ﷺ ne us se poocha: "Kya tumhare ghar mein kuch hai?"

dialogue.ar: قالَ: نَعَمْ، قَصْعَةٌ نَأْكُلُ فيها، وَنَشْرَبُ مِنْها وَنَتَطَهَّرُ، وَحِلْسٌ نَجْلِسُ عَلَيْهِ، وَلا شَيْءَ غَيْرُ هَذا.
dialogue.tr: qāla: naʿam, qaṣʿatun naʾkulu fīhā, wa nashrabu minhā wa natatahharu, wa ḥilsun najlisu ʿalayh, wa lā shayʾa ghayru hādhā
dialogue.en: He said: "Yes, a bowl we eat from, drink from and wash with, and a rug we sit on; nothing else."
dialogue.ur: Us ne kaha: "Haan, ek piyala jis mein khate, peete aur wuzu karte hain, aur ek chatai jis par baithte hain; iske siwa kuch nahin."

dialogue.ar: فَقالَ لَهُ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: ائْتِني بِهِما. فَأَتاهُ بِهِما، فَأَمْسَكَهُما بِيَدَيْهِ، وَقالَ لِأَصْحابِهِ: مَنْ يَشْتَري هَذَيْنِ؟
dialogue.tr: fa-qāla lahu r-rasūl: iʾtinī bihimā. fa-ātāhu bihimā, fa-amsakahumā bi-yadayh, wa qāla li-aṣḥābih: man yashtarī hādhayn?
dialogue.en: The Messenger ﷺ said to him: "Bring them to me." He brought them, and the Prophet held them in his hands and said to his companions: "Who will buy these two?"
dialogue.ur: Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Dono cheezein mere paas lao." Woh le aaya. Aap ﷺ ne unhein haathon mein liya aur sahaba se farmaya: "In dono ko kaun khareedega?"

dialogue.ar: فَقامَ رَجُلٌ فَقالَ: أَنا أَشْتَريهِما بِدِرْهَمٍ. فَقالَ: مَنْ يَزيدُ عَلى دِرْهَمٍ؟ فَقامَ رَجُلٌ آخَرُ، وَقالَ: أَنا أَشْتَريهِما بِدِرْهَمَيْنِ، فَدَفَعَهُما إِلى الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: fa-qāma rajulun fa-qāl: anā ashtarīhimā bi-dirham. fa-qāl: man yazīdu ʿalā dirham? fa-qāma rajulun ākhar, wa qāl: anā ashtarīhimā bi-dirhamayn, fa-dafaʿahumā ilā r-rasūl
dialogue.en: A man stood up and said: "I will buy them for one dirham." He said: "Who offers more than a dirham?" Another man stood and said: "I will buy them for two dirhams," and he paid the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Ek aadmi ne uth kar kaha: "Main ek dirham mein khareedta hoon." Aap ﷺ ne farmaya: "Ek dirham se zyada kaun deta hai?" Doosre ne kaha: "Main do dirham mein khareedta hoon," aur Aap ﷺ ko ada kar diye.

dialogue.ar: ثُمَّ أَعْطى الدِّرْهَمَيْنِ لِلْأَعْرابِيِّ قائِلاً: اشْتَرِ بِأَحَدِهِما طَعاماً، وَاذْهَبْ بِهِ إِلى أَهْلِكَ، وَاشْتَرِ بِالآخَرِ قَدُّوماً وَائْتِني بِهِ.
dialogue.tr: thumma aʿṭā d-dirhamayni lil-aʿrābiyyi qāʾilan: ishtari bi-aḥadihimā ṭaʿāman, wa dhhab bihī ilā ahlik, wa ishtari bil-ākhari qaddūman wa-ʾtinī bih
dialogue.en: Then he gave the two dirhams to the man, saying: "Buy food with one and take it to your family, and buy an axe with the other and bring it to me."
dialogue.ur: Phir Aap ﷺ ne woh do dirham us aadmi ko diye aur farmaya: "Ek se khana kharid kar apne ghar walon ko do, aur doosre se kulhari kharid kar mere paas lao."

dialogue.ar: فَأَتاهُ بِالقَدّومِ، فَوَضَعَ فيهِ عوداً بِيَدِهِ، وَقالَ لَهُ: اذْهَبْ فَاحْتَطِبْ وَبِعْ، وَلا أَراكَ خَمْسَةَ عَشَرَ يَوْماً.
dialogue.tr: fa-ātāhu bil-qaddūm, fa-waḍaʿa fīhi ʿūdan bi-yadih, wa qāla lah: idhhab fa-ḥtaṭib wa biʿ, wa lā arāka khamsata ʿashara yawmā
dialogue.en: He brought the axe, and the Prophet ﷺ fixed a wooden handle in it with his own hand and said: "Go, gather wood and sell it, and let me not see you for fifteen days."
dialogue.ur: Woh kulhari le aaya. Aap ﷺ ne apne haath se us mein lakdi ka dasta lagaya aur farmaya: "Ja, lakdiyan kaat aur bech, aur main tujhe pandrah din tak na dekhun."

dialogue.ar: وَبَعْدَ انْتِهاءِ هَذِهِ المُدَّةِ، رَجَعَ إِلَيْهِ الأَعْرابِيُّ، وَقَدِ اشْتَرى ثِياباً وَطَعاماً، فَقالَ لَهُ الرَّسولُ ﷺ: أَلَيْسَ هَذا خَيْراً لَكَ مِنْ أَنْ تَسْأَلَ النّاسَ، أَعْطَوْكَ أَوْ مَنَعوكَ؟
dialogue.tr: wa baʿda intihāʾi hādhihi l-mudda, rajaʿa ilayhi l-aʿrābiyy, wa qadi shtarā thiyāban wa ṭaʿāmā, fa-qāla lahu r-rasūl: a-laysa hādhā khayran laka min an tasʾala n-nās, aʿṭawka aw manaʿūk?
dialogue.en: After this period ended, the man returned to him, having bought clothes and food. The Messenger ﷺ said to him: "Is this not better for you than asking people, whether they give you or refuse you?"
dialogue.ur: Is muddat ke baad woh aadmi lautaa; usne kapde aur khana khareed liya tha. Rasoolullah ﷺ ne farmaya: "Kya yeh tumhare liye logon se maangne se behtar nahin, chahe woh dete ya inkar karte?"

q.en: What is work, according to the text?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq kaam kya hai?

q.en: The Prophet ﷺ told the poor man to:
q.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne faqeer se kaha:
q.ar: أَمَرَ النَّبِيُّ ﷺ الرَّجُلَ الفَقيرَ أَنْ:

options: Go, cut wood and sell it

intro.en: To make the sound feminine plural, add «ـات» (alif + ta) to the end of the singular: جامِعَة → جامِعات، حُكومَة → حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة → خِبْراتٌ. The «ة» drops away.
intro.ur: Jam' muannas salim banane ke liye wahid ke aakhir mein «ـات» (alif + ta) lagate hain: جامِعَة → جامِعات، حُكومَة → حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة → خِبْراتٌ. «ة» hat jati hai.
intro.ar: لِجَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ نُضيفُ «ـات» إِلى آخِرِ المُفْرَدِ وَتَسْقُطُ التّاءُ المَرْبوطَةُ: جامِعَة ← جامِعات، حُكومَة ← حُكوماتٌ، خِبْرَة ← خِبْراتٌ.

q.en: What is added to make the sound feminine plural?
q.ur: Jam' muannas salim ke liye kya lagate hain?
q.ar: ما الَّذي يُضافُ لِتَكْوينِ جَمْعِ المُؤَنَّثِ السّالِمِ؟

intro.en: Practise writing short sentences about people at work: a beggar, a man who eats from his own labour, a young man who depends on his father, the opinions about women working, and the jobs of a doctor, a teacher and a farmer.
intro.ur: Chhote jumle likhne ki mashq: bheek mangne wala, apni mehnat ki kamai khane wala, apne walid par bharosa karne wala naujawan, aurat ke kaam par raayein, aur doctor, ustaad aur kisan ka kaam.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى كِتابَةِ جُمَلٍ قَصيرَةٍ عَنِ النّاسِ في العَمَلِ: المُتَسَوِّلُ، وَمَنْ يَأْكُلُ مِنْ عَمَلِ يَدِهِ، وَالشّابُّ المُعْتَمِدُ عَلى أَبيهِ، وَآراءُ النّاسِ في عَمَلِ المَرْأَةِ، وَمِهَنُ الطَّبيبِ وَالمُدَرِّسِ وَالفَلّاحِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني مَنْ يَزْرَعُ الأَرْضَ؟

options: He took care of his children

intro.en: Write in Naskh script. Spelling rule: the hamza of «اِبْن» and «اِبْنَة» is dropped when they come between two names, for example: «عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ».
intro.ur: Naskh khat mein likhein. Imla ka usool: «اِبْن» aur «اِبْنَة» ka hamza us waqt hazf ho jata hai jab yeh do naamon ke darmiyan aayein, jaise: «عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ».
intro.ar: نَكْتُبُ بِخَطِّ النَّسْخِ. قاعِدَةُ الإِمْلاءِ: تُحْذَفُ هَمْزَةُ «اِبْن» وَ«اِبْنَة» إِذا وَقَعَتا بَيْنَ عَلَمَيْنِ، مِثْلُ: «عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ».

dialogue.ar: عُمَرُ بْنُ الخَطّابِ خَليفَةٌ عادِلٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿumaru bnu l-khaṭṭābi khalīfatun ʿādil
dialogue.en: Umar ibn al-Khattab is a just caliph.
dialogue.ur: Umar bin Khattab ek adil khalifa hain.

dialogue.ar: حَفْصَةُ بِنْتُ عُمَرَ زَوْجَةُ الرَّسولِ.
dialogue.tr: ḥafṣatu bintu ʿumara zawjatu r-rasūl
dialogue.en: Hafsa bint Umar is the wife of the Messenger.
dialogue.ur: Hafsa bint Umar Rasool ﷺ ki zaujah hain.

dialogue.ar: عَبْدُ اللهِ بْنُ المُبارَكِ عالِمٌ.
dialogue.tr: ʿAbdu llāhi bnu l-mubārak ʿālim
dialogue.en: Abdullah ibn al-Mubarak is a scholar.
dialogue.ur: Abdullah bin Mubarak ek aalim hain.

dialogue.ar: عائِشَةُ بِنْتُ أَبي بَكْرٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿāʾishatu bintu abī bakr
dialogue.en: Aisha bint Abu Bakr.
dialogue.ur: Aisha bint Abu Bakr.

dialogue.ar: عَلِيُّ بْنُ أَبي طالِبٍ.
dialogue.tr: ʿaliyyu bnu abī ṭālib
dialogue.en: Ali ibn Abi Talib.
dialogue.ur: Ali bin Abi Talib.

q.en: When is the hamza of «اِبْن» dropped in writing?
q.ur: «اِبْن» ka hamza kab hazf hota hai?

options: At the start of a sentence

q.en: Which script is used for the calligraphy practice?
q.ur: Khushkhati ke liye kaun sa khat hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ خَطٍّ نَسْتَعْمِلُهُ في تَدْريبِ الخَطِّ هُنا؟

q.en: «عائِشَةُ بِنْتُ أَبي بَكْرٍ» — which word has no hamza?
q.ur: «عائِشَةُ بِنْتُ أَبي بَكْرٍ» mein kis lafz mein hamza nahin?
q.ar: في «عائِشَةُ بِنْتُ أَبي بَكْرٍ»، أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ لَيْسَ فيها هَمْزَةٌ؟

intro.en: A review for units 5 and 6: reading comprehension, listening, plurals (singular, dual, plural), matching words that go together, and correcting spelling mistakes.
intro.ur: Unit 5 aur 6 ki dohrai: parhna, sunna, wahid, musanna aur jama, saath aane wale alfaaz ka milaan aur imla ki ghaltiyan theek karna.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلْوَحْدَتَيْنِ الخامِسَةِ وَالسّادِسَةِ: فَهْمُ المَقْروءِ وَالمَسْموعِ، وَالمُفْرَدُ وَالمُثَنّى وَالجَمْعُ، وَمُطابَقَةُ الكَلِماتِ، وَتَصْحيحُ الأَخْطاءِ الإِمْلائِيَّةِ.

q.ar: أَيُّ كَلِمَةٍ تَعْني عَدَمَ وُجودِ فُرْصَةِ عَمَلٍ؟
